# CANDIDATE: VWAP_DEVIATION_MEANREVERT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An extended deviation (>1.5 × ATR) above VWAP paired with a rejecting shooting‑star bar and weakening volume often precedes a short‑term reversion to VWAP. This mean-reversion edge exists because overextended prices tend to revert to the mean (VWAP) when accompanied by bearish price action (shooting star) and low volume (lack of conviction).

## Mechanism

Entry: When price > VWAP + 1.5 × ATR(20) and the current bar forms a shooting star (upper wick ≥ 2 × body, body in the lower third of the bar) AND its volume is < 0.8 × the average volume of the prior five bars, enter short at the bar’s close.  
Exit: Stop placed above the high of the entry bar; primary target is a re‑test of VWAP (exit when price crosses VWAP) with an optional trail of 0.5 × ATR if price stays below VWAP after exit.
